Anammox-based wastewater treatment processes offer promising benefits in reducing carbon emissions but mainstream practical operation faces unclear external regulation strategies
H2O AutoML algorithm and interpretable analysis used to capture internal relationships in big dataset from anammox-based municipal wastewater studies
XGBoost and GBM models generated by AutoML provided most accurate predictions with R2 = 0.814-0.993
